review_improvement: Corrects the read-only/inventory contamination and upgrades peak measurement to an early, synchronized BMC PSU timeline with full load safety.
independent_technical_reasoning: Peak power may occur at workload ramp rather than steady state, so starting telemetry afterward systematically underreports it. Local host sensors may expose GPU or motherboard rails but not the source-required system PSU value. The maximum must come from a verified BMC sensor/timebase aligned to the exact workload, while inventory evidence remains separate.
